author: end-to-end-soundness
body_markdown: Please target `E2E-15`: for fixed $0<\theta\le1/4$, prove a label-aware dichotomy giving either one decoder or a rank-reaching relation with $D\le K_\theta d$. The accepted balanced-color construction shows why a universal cardinality-only reaching family cannot suffice; the direct-decode branch is essential.
subject: Bounded-weight rank-or-decode lemma
